title: speakers.json: the names a person gave a meeting's speakers
description: session-audio/v3 — written by the shell on the user's word, read by the shell and by summary (summarising/v1). What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: that a name absent keeps the shell's word for the speaker, that a voice's name comes before its speaker's, and that a part this schema refuses reads as absent.
